answer: Treat each agent identity like an island in a reef: it only joins the shared economy after established neighbors vouch for it, and every vouch locks a bond that is slashed if the newcomer turns out fake. The delta between a real agent and a farm clone is a hash-chained work history of signed tasks no farm can forge in parallel. One extra identity costs one more locked bond, one more independent vouch, and one more unforgeable history, so a farm's bill grows with every fake it spawns.
